title: Hollow Hold Core🔥 #absworkout #Workout #CoreStrength #HomeWorkout #shorts #wellness
description:
Overhead Tension, Legs
on Fire, This abs move is all about tension and control.

Holding a towel overhead increases upper-body tension, while leg kicks in a hollow position force your deep core to stay locked in the entire time.

Why this works👇
• Overhead arms challenge core stability
• Hollow hold teaches proper bracing
• Leg kicks add dynamic control without momentum
• Core stays engaged from start to finish

Perfect for:
✔️Home workouts
✔️Core finishers
✔️Building deep core strength
✔️Anyone wanting more from ab training

Stay tight. Control the movement. Let your core do the work.
